title: Dashboards
detailNotPublished: Dashboard “{{token}}” has not been published yet. Ask an author to publish it.
schemaTooNew: This dashboard was saved by a newer version of DeviceChain. Upgrade this console to open it.
workspaceDiscardDescription: Your unsaved dashboard edits will be lost.
workspaceConflictMessage: This dashboard changed elsewhere. Reload the page to get the latest, then reapply your edits.
workspaceRollbackParseError: Rolled back, but the returned version could not be parsed. Reload the page.
workspaceClipboardUnavailable: Clipboard unavailable here — use Download instead.
workspaceUnknownOptionsRemoved: Removed options no widget reads. Review and save.
workspacePreviewHint: Preview with synthetic data (no device required)
workspaceConvertedNotice: Converted from the previous grid. Review the layout, then save to keep it in the new format.
workspaceConvertedWindowsNotice_one: This board’s chart ({{charts}}) kept a sample count, which has no time span. It now follows the board’s time range; pin a span in its settings if it should differ. Save to keep the new format.
workspaceConvertedWindowsNotice_other: {{count}} of this board’s charts ({{charts}}) kept a sample count, which has no time span. They now follow the board’s time range; pin a span in a chart’s settings if it should differ. Save to keep the new format.
versionHistoryDescription: Publish the current draft as an immutable version that goes live for viewers, make an earlier version live without touching the draft, or roll the draft back to a previous one. History is append-only.
versionLabelHint: Optional — e.g. a release name or v1.2.0.
versionOlderNotShown: Showing the newest {{count}} versions. Older versions are not listed.
versionPublished: Published version {{version}}; it is now live for viewers
versionPublishGoesLive: Publishing makes the new version the one viewers are shown.
versionActivated: Version {{version}} is now live for viewers
versionPublishConflict: This dashboard changed elsewhere. Reload the page before publishing.
versionRollbackConflict: This dashboard changed elsewhere. Reload the page before rolling back.
versionPublishBlocked_one: {{count}} widget option must be fixed before this dashboard can be published.
versionPublishBlocked_other: {{count}} widget options must be fixed before this dashboard can be published.
optionIssueUnknown: {{key}} is not read by this widget
optionIssueEnum: {{key}} is not one of the allowed values
versionRollbackConfirmDescription: This replaces the current draft with that version. The current draft — including saved changes you have not published — will be lost.
widgetUnknownBody: This widget was added in a newer release, so this console cannot show or configure it. It is saved back unchanged, and you can still move, resize or delete it.
widgetDerivedFromParentWithSlot: Derived from the parent context (slot <mono>{{slotName}}</mono>). This widget follows the selected context and any drill-down.
widgetDerivedFromParentNoSlot: Derived from the parent context. This widget follows the selected context and any drill-down.
widgetNoScopeSelected: No scope selected — showing all alarms (tenant-wide).
widgetHintFontSize: Height of the text in pixels at the comfortable density. It grows and shrinks with the board density.
widgetHintStat: Which figure of the time span to show. The latest reading covers no span: it is the newest reading received.
widgetSortNone: As the data source lists them
widgetHintScaleMin: The value at the empty end of the scale. Required: the widget does not guess a range.
widgetHintScaleMax: The value at the full end of the scale. Required, and above Min.
widgetHintBatteryRange: Leave Min and Max blank for a percent scale (0 to 100), or set both to show another unit such as volts.
widgetHintOnAt: For an on/off signal: the light is on at or above this value and off below it. Blank keeps the light on while a value is present, coloured by its band.
widgetHintControlParameter: Which parameter of the command this control sets. Leave blank when the command has exactly one parameter of the right type. The control never guesses between two.
widgetHintSliderRange: Used only when the command definition declares no limit for the parameter. The definition's own range always wins.
widgetHintSliderStep: Distance between values. Blank means 1 for a whole-number parameter, else a hundredth of the range.
widgetHintSignalThresholds: The steps of the signal, lowest first: one bar per row, lit once the value reaches it and coloured by its level. At least two rows, at most eight.
widgetHintMeasurement: Which measurement to show. Blank shows the first the data source selects.
widgetHintWindow: Samples kept in memory across all of this widget’s measurements. This bounds memory and changes nothing you can see.
widgetHintWindowSeconds: How much history the widget covers, in seconds (60 to 604800). Leave blank to follow the board’s time range, which a viewer can change; set it to pin this widget to a fixed span.
widgetHintStaleAfter: When the newest sample is older than this, the value is greyed out and badged as stale. Leave blank to show the sample's age only; no widget is ever marked stale without a value here.
widgetHintAlarmGroupBy: Show a tab per device type, each with a badge counting its active alarms.
widgetHintAlarmDeviceTypes: Which device types get a tab, and in what order. Leave empty to show every type with an active alarm. A type not listed is under All only.
widgetMaxRowsCommandHint: Recent commands shown in the history before scrolling.
widgetHintPrecision: Decimal places for numeric values (blank = full precision).
widgetTileUrlHint: Raster tile template, for example https://tiles.example.com/{z}/{x}/{y}.png. Leave empty to use the tenant's basemap, which is what most boards should do. Setting one here overrides it for this board only — and needs the credit line the provider's licence requires.
widgetAttributionHint: The credit line your tile provider requires. Shown on the map.
widgetTileUncredited: This tile URL has no credit line, so it is ignored and the widget draws the tenant basemap instead. A tile source and the attribution its licence requires are used together or not at all.
widgetHintThresholds: Each row starts a severity band at its value; the band runs until the next row. Below the first row, and in a Normal band, the widget keeps its ordinary colour: only abnormal levels are coloured.
widgetFlashOnChangeHint: Briefly highlight a value green when it rises and red when it falls.
widgetMetricCalculatedTitle: Computed from a formula when each reading arrives; devices do not report it.
widgetCommandSelectDevice: Select a target device to choose a command.
widgetCommandStale: “{{commandName}}” isn’t available on this device. Pick a command below.
widgetCommandNoneDefined: This device’s profile defines no commands. Add a command definition to its device profile.
widgetCommandUnpublishedHint: This profile isn’t published, so these definitions aren’t enforced yet and any command is accepted. Publish it to hold this button to the contract.
widgetCommandDraftOnlyLabel: Authored but not published, so not selectable yet:
widgetCommandDraftOnlyPublishHint_one: Publish the device profile to use it here.
widgetCommandDraftOnlyPublishHint_other: Publish the device profile to use them here.
widgetContextEmptyHint: Add a widget bound to a customer, area, or asset to use as a parent context — then this slot can follow it.
widgetBindsToHint: Root: chosen directly or by a context selector. Scoped: follows a parent context (e.g. a device within the selected building).
widgetStrategyHint: First: auto-follow the parent's first member. Manual: keep a chosen member (a picker offers the parent's members).
widgetSelectionTargetEmptyHint: This dashboard has no slots yet. Bind a widget to a device or anchor first, then this picker can re-point it.
widgetTargetSlotHint: The slot this picker re-points. A scoped slot becomes a member picker; a root slot a context picker.
widgetNotInstalled: This widget type is not installed in this console, so its settings cannot be shown.
versionUnresolvedWarning_one: Warning: {{count}} widget in that version cannot be resolved by this console and will not render here until its package is installed:
versionUnresolvedWarning_other: Warning: {{count}} widgets in that version cannot be resolved by this console and will not render here until their packages are installed:
versionUnresolvedUnchecked: This console could not read that version to check it for widgets it cannot render, so it has not been checked. You can still go ahead.
versionUnresolvedBlocked_one: {{count}} widget on this dashboard cannot be resolved by this console, so a new version cannot be published. Install its package or remove the widget. Saving the draft still keeps its stored settings unchanged.
versionUnresolvedBlocked_other: {{count}} widgets on this dashboard cannot be resolved by this console, so a new version cannot be published. Install their packages or remove the widgets. Saving the draft still keeps their stored settings unchanged.
unresolvedReasonUnregistered: its package is not installed in this console
unresolvedReasonUnversioned: it was saved without version information
unresolvedReasonInvalidMetadata: its stored version information is not valid
unresolvedReasonOptionsVersion: it was saved with a different settings version than the installed package uses
unresolvedReasonSdkIncompatible: it was written for a different widget SDK version
widgetVersionDrift: Authored with version {{authored}}. This console renders it with version {{installed}}; check that it still looks right.
widgetEditorFailed: This widget's settings editor stopped with an error. Your other changes are kept; the details are in the browser console.
widgetEditorWriteFailed: The settings editor tried to save a value this widget cannot hold, so nothing was changed: {{error}}
widgetEditorServiceFailed: The settings editor asked this console for information and the request failed: {{error}}
importDescription: Create a new dashboard from exported JSON. It is saved as a draft under a new token; nothing is overwritten and nothing is published.
importJsonHint: Paste an exported definition, or choose a .json file. The dashboard can be up to 1 MiB, not counting indentation.
importChecking: Checking the definition and its bindings…
importTokenHint: The new dashboard's token. It must not belong to an existing dashboard.
importDraftNote: The dashboard is created as a draft. Publish it from the editor when it is ready.
importErrorTooLarge: The definition is larger than the {{limit}} MiB limit.
importErrorTextTooLarge: The text is larger than the {{limit}} MiB an import reads.
importErrorInvalid: This is not a dashboard definition this console can read: {{detail}}
importUnresolvedNote: They are kept as placeholders in the draft, exactly as stored. Publishing stays blocked until each one is installed or removed.
importConcreteNote: {{n}} widget(s) name devices or entities directly instead of through a slot. Check them in the editor; they may not exist in this tenant.
importExternalNote: Images, map tiles or backgrounds in this definition are fetched from these sites whenever the dashboard is opened. Remove any you do not recognize in the editor.
importBindingsNote: Pick an entity from this tenant for each one, or leave it empty to import the slot unbound and bind it later.
importBindingMissing: The {{kind}} “{{token}}” does not exist in this tenant.
importBindingUnsupported: This binding names an entity type this console cannot look up. It will be imported unbound.
linkBlockedTitle: This link can't open the board as asked
linkUnknownSlot: The board has no slot named "{{slot}}".
linkNotDeviceSlot: The slot "{{slot}}" takes a group, not a single device.
linkDuplicateSlot: The link names the slot "{{slot}}" more than once.
linkDerivedSlot: The slot "{{slot}}" follows another slot, so a link can't choose its device.
linkInvalidToken: "{{token}}" is not a valid device token (slot "{{slot}}").
linkMissing: Device "{{token}}" (slot "{{slot}}") doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.
templatesNote: A starter layout you can bind to your own devices before saving. It is created as a draft. The measurement names it uses (such as temperature and humidity) are examples: change them in the editor to the ones your devices report.
templateFleetOverviewDescription: Active alarm counts by severity, an alarm table, and a featured device you pick.
templateDeviceDetailDescription: Latest values, gauge, telemetry chart, location and alarms for one device.
templateAlarmsBoardDescription: Alarm counts and tables for the whole tenant, active and recently cleared.
canvasWidgetLabel: {{name}}, {{size}} at column {{col}}, row {{row}}. Arrow keys move it, Shift with arrow keys resizes it.
canvasWidgetLabelRelative: {{name}}, placed relative to another widget. Arrow keys move it, Shift with arrow keys moves it by quarter cells.
canvasAnnounceOffset: {{name}} is now offset {{x}}, {{y}} cells from its anchor
canvasPickHost: Click the widget this one should hang from, or focus it and press Enter. Press Esc to cancel.
workspaceUndoHint: Undo (Ctrl+Z, or Cmd+Z on a Mac)
workspaceRedoHint: Redo (Ctrl+Shift+Z or Ctrl+Y, or Cmd+Shift+Z on a Mac)
workspacePasteHint: Paste the widget last copied in this tab (Ctrl+V pastes from the clipboard)
workspacePasteEmpty: Nothing to paste: copy a widget first.
workspacePasteRefused: Not pasted: {{type}} is not available in this console. {{reason}}
workspacePasteTooNew: Not pasted: this widget was copied in a newer version of DeviceChain. Upgrade this console to paste it.
pasteUnboundMissing: {{name}} was pasted without a data source: this dashboard has no slot {{slot}}. Choose its data source in the widget's settings.
pasteUnboundDifferent: {{name}} was pasted without a data source: this dashboard's slot {{slot}} shows something else. Choose its data source in the widget's settings.
pasteUnboundTenant: {{name}} was pasted without a data source: it was copied in another tenant, and devices are never carried between tenants. Choose its data source in the widget's settings.
layoutFindingSpan: Size is outside what this widget supports
layoutFindingOverrun: Runs past the right edge of the grid
layoutFindingNoLayout: This widget declares no size limits
layoutFindingTitle: The title repeats the subject line
layoutFitToLimitsHint: Clamp every widget into the sizes it supports and bring every widget back onto the canvas
layoutFitted: Widgets fitted to their size limits.
layoutAlreadyFits: Every widget already fits its limits.
versionLayoutBlocked_one: {{count}} widget is outside its supported size or off the canvas and must be fixed before this dashboard can be published.
versionLayoutBlocked_other: {{count}} widgets are outside their supported size or off the canvas and must be fixed before this dashboard can be published.
widgetHintColumns: Heading, unit and precision for each measurement column. A column without an entry shows the measurement name.
widgetHintSortBy: The measurement the table is ordered by. Leave blank to order by device name. Viewers can re-order from the column headings.
widgetHintAgeLag: Show a reading's age under it only when it is at least this many seconds older than the newest reading in the table, or stale. Leave blank to show every reading's age.
widgetHintGroupBy: What a bar stands for: each measurement of one device, or each device of the group for the one measurement chosen below.
widgetHintFleetShow: Devices needing attention: how many have a latest reading of the measurement in an abnormal band of the thresholds below. Devices: how many devices the group holds.
widgetHintSparkline: Draw the measurement’s trend over the card’s span under the figure. Left out when the card is too small to keep the figure readable.
emptyShared: No dashboards have been shared with you yet.
shareDescription: Users limited to the chosen customers or groups can list this dashboard and open its published version, here and in the dashboard app. They never see the draft.
shareLoading: Loading who the dashboard is shared with…
shareNotPublished: This dashboard has not been published yet. The customers and groups it is shared with see it once it is.
shareCustomersDescription: Together with the groups below, replaces the current list. Leave both empty to share with nobody.
shareGroupsDescription: Members limited to one of these groups see the dashboard. Only groups used as an access scope are offered: if a group is missing, enable it as an access scope on the group's page.
shareGroupsEmpty: No access-scope group matches. Enable a group as an access scope on its page.
shareTargetMissing: A chosen customer no longer exists, or a chosen group is no longer an access scope. Reload and try again.
sharedToast_one: {{name}} is shared with {{count}} customer or group.
sharedToast_other: {{name}} is shared with {{count}} customers and groups.
sharedWithNobody: {{name}} is no longer shared with anyone.
boardFromProfileTitle: Create a dashboard for this device type
boardFromProfileIntro: Builds a starting board from what the profile declares: a device selector, a card per measurement, a chart, the alarms and the commands that are safe to send. Edit it freely afterwards.
boardFromProfileLoadError: The profile could not be read.
boardFromProfileNoMeasurements: This profile declares no measurements, so there is nothing to build a board from. Add measurements to the profile, then try again.
boardFromProfileMeasurementsLeftOut: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} measurements. Add the rest in the editor.
boardFromProfileCommandsLeftOut_one: {{count}} command was left out because sending it from a board is not safe (it is disruptive or its impact is unknown).
boardFromProfileCommandsLeftOut_other: {{count}} commands were left out because sending them from a board is not safe (they are disruptive or their impact is unknown).
boardFromProfileNoDevice: This type has no devices yet, so the selector starts unbound.
boardFromProfileBasisDraft: Built from the profile's draft, because the profile has never been published. A measurement the draft names is not accepted until the profile is published.
boardFromProfileSelectorScope: The device selector lists every device in the tenant, not only devices of this type.
boardFromProfileInvalid: The generated board is not valid: {{detail}}
